findings.observation: At actual360x203 the three headings Präparieren/Beobachten/Auswerten and both Zellkern/Zytoplasma labels are readable. Purple nucleus, yellow cytoplasm and the two bold pointer endpoints are independently distinguishable. At680x383 they are clear. findings.scope: The current stipulated360/680 inspection passes for the five important words and represented acts; this is not a guarantee for arbitrary smaller rendering.

findings.observation: The Zellkern black endpoint lies inside the purple nucleus, separate from the yellow cytoplasm. The Zytoplasma endpoint lies in the yellow interior away from the nucleus and outside the depicted mitochondria. Thick contrasting leaders remain identifiable when the whole image is reduced to360px.
findings.scope: This is a schematic animal-cell example. The decorative organelles do not claim routine light-microscope resolution of cristae or a real observed specimen.

findings.observation: One main slide bears a drop, and one square coverslip is held at a slant above it with a tool. The hands and glass pieces are recognisable, with no second floating specimen slide.
findings.scope: The single illustrated wet-mount action supports preparation orientation; it is not a complete method-selection or sample-preparation protocol for all biological/chemical materials.

findings.observation: Both shown people visibly wear protective goggles over both eyes. They are recognisable at360px. The earlier absent-goggles depiction has been corrected.
findings.scope: Visible goggles do not prove complete safety controls, actual supervised conduct, risk assessment or observance of all P protocol steps.

findings.scope: This remains a friendly schematic orientation image, not a measured optics diagram or evidence of safe focusing.
